title: Life Path Number 2: The Peacemaker
name: The Peacemaker
intro: Life Path 2 people are gentle, intuitive and cooperative. They notice feelings, bring people together and work best in a team. Their kindness makes others feel safe.
love: In love, 2s are devoted romantics who value harmony, tenderness and loyalty.
career: Counselor, mediator, teacher, designer or any role built on teamwork.
